opening.argument: This is a corporate presentation about Coinbase’s trading products and business developments, not a promise of personal returns. The speaker identifies herself as Coinbase’s VP of markets, describes futures trading through Coinbase Prime, and reports an expansion of maximum leverage. The presentation also discusses the Deribit acquisition and planned additions to the international derivatives offering. These are operational and product updates; the figures are not presented as guaranteed gains. Nothing in the supplied material asks viewers for payment, credentials, or financial participation. A request to subscribe does not, by itself, establish a scam mechanism.

citations.quote: I'm Liz Martin, VP of markets at Coinbase.
clients can trade all these futures directly through Coinbase Prime
we've expanded our maximum leverage up to 50 times
the acquisition and onboarding of Darebit
we're working on adding stock perps to the international derivatives offering
